text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The cheers from the stands... are echoing 
all the way over here, aren't they...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is expecting it, aren't they? A 
race that sets their hearts ablaze.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I must do everything in my power to live 
up to their expectations...!
choice_data_list:
Don't put too much pressure on yourself, 
alright?

Don't put too much pressure on yourself, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll run with everything I have, true 
to myself!
